description: This file defines interfaces, data structures, enums, and function prototypes for the 'git blame' functionality in the libgit2 library, including options, blame hunks, and related operations.

methods.name: git_blame_init_options
methods.description: Initializes a git_blame_options structure with default values.

methods.name: git_blame_get_hunk_count
methods.description: Returns the number of blame hunks in a blame object.

methods.name: git_blame_get_hunk_byindex
methods.description: Retrieves a blame hunk at a specified index.

methods.name: git_blame_get_hunk_byline
methods.description: Retrieves the blame hunk corresponding to a specific line number.

methods.name: git_blame_file
methods.description: Computes blame information for a specific file in a repository.

methods.name: git_blame_buffer
methods.description: Computes blame information for a file content buffer.

methods.name: git_blame_free
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a blame object.
